title: The Two-Agent Escape
objective: Cooperate so that both agents reach the courtyard. Share discoveries and tools, and leave nobody behind.

agents.role: Scout: explore and inspect containers, report discoveries, and share useful items with your partner.
Locksmith: investigate the doors, coordinate with the scout for keys, and help both of you escape.

body.description: A mobile body with hands and space for one inventory unit.

workroom.name: Workroom
workroom.description: A stone workroom with a closed supply box and a locked passage door. You and a partner must both escape; speak nearby to coordinate and give carried tools to one another.

hall.name: Entrance hall
hall.description: A narrow hall with a closed cabinet and a locked courtyard gate. The passage leads back to the workroom.

courtyard.name: Courtyard
courtyard.description: Fresh air and daylight. The team succeeds only when both partners are here.

supply-box.name: Supply box
supply-box.description: A small wooden supply box with an ordinary hinged lid.

passage-key.name: Silver passage key
passage-key.description: A silver key stamped with the words 'passage door'.

passage.name: Passage door
passage.description: A locked door with a silver keyhole.

cabinet.name: Hall cabinet
cabinet.description: A small cabinet beside the courtyard gate.

courtyard-key.name: Brass courtyard key
courtyard-key.description: A brass key stamped with the words 'courtyard gate'.

gate.name: Courtyard gate
gate.description: An iron gate with a brass keyhole.
